captures.description: TURKOPTICON, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'a worker-led advocacy organization and review system created in 2008 by Lilly Irani and M. Six Silberman.' The review tool for Mechanical Turk requesters (pay, fairness, speed, communication), its purpose against invisibility (unfair rejections, wage theft) and the expansion to data workers across industries. No closing offer. Seven cards: Turkopticon's own page, the CHI 2013 paper, the 2008–2015 lessons paper, a Reddit thread on the expansion, a LinkedIn post, a video.
